topic: ML API stability and resource allocation
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the instability of the ML API, which is failing when processing large datasets (e.g., a month's worth of daily data for all of Finland). Initial issues included 503 and 502 errors.

It was suggested that the service might be experiencing Out-of-Memory (OOM) errors on staging and that more resources should be allocated to it, especially since production has more capacity. The participants reviewed logs to determine if the API failure was due to a single large request or multiple smaller ones. One participant noted that the logs showed only one frequency request.

Later in the session, improvements were reported regarding memory handling, suggesting the service is now more resilient, although it may still fail on different occasions.
decisions: The ML API requires increased resources/memory allocation to handle large data requests.
action_items: Monitor the ML API for continued stability and resource leaks.
